title: Illumina, the DNA sequencing giant, gives Wall Street bad news
text: Illumina, the world's largest maker of DNA sequencing technology, has delivered disappointing news to investors, announcing a lower profit outlook for 2023. Consequently, Illumina's stock price has significantly dropped from its peak in 2021.

title: Apple’s Reliance On China Poses A Problem For The Company
text: This article discusses Apple's significant reliance on its supply chain in China and the challenges this poses for the company amidst growing geopolitical tensions and trade barriers between the US and China. title: Tesla video promoting self-driving was staged, engineer testifies
text: A senior Tesla engineer testified that a 2016 video promoting the company's self-driving technology was staged, showcasing features like stopping at red lights and accelerating at green lights that the system did not possess at the time.
